verdict.rationale: Mistral explicitly documents open-weight models (e.g., Mistral 7B, Mistral Small 4) under Apache 2.0 for research/individual use, states self-hosting is possible, and publishes a dedicated 'Model weights' page with download links plus per-model cards clarifying licensing terms (open-weight vs commercial), giving a clear and honest stance on which weights are open vs closed for commercial use. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of actually downloading and running the weights, and more detail on which specific frontier models remain closed-weight only.
